credentials.title: AI keys
credentials.intro: The API keys the provider calls run on. Every generation runs on one of these and is billed for real.
credentials.caption: AI keys
credentials.deleteBody: This key has never run a generation, so nothing in the history points at it. It is removed for good.
credentials.empty: No keys yet. Without one, every generate call stops at the first step.
credentials.noDefault: No key is marked as default. A generate call that names no key will fail with "credential not found".
credentials.modelUnsupported: {label} — cannot be forced into a JSON schema, unusable
credentials.modelsLoadFailed: Could not load the model list. Reload the page to try again.

fields.label: Label
fields.apiKeyHint: Accepted once. There is no way to read it back — lose it and you rotate.
fields.rotateHint: Leave empty to keep the current key.
fields.isDefault: Use this key when a generate call names none
fields.budgetHint: Leave empty for unlimited. Counted per calendar month, UTC.
fields.budgetInvalid: A whole number of tokens, at least 1.

templates.title: Prompts
templates.intro: Prompts for the two stages: turning sources into an outline, and writing questions. A prompt is yours to write — none are seeded.
templates.caption: Prompts
templates.duplicateIntro: The prompt, defaults and description are copied. Only the name and key are yours to set — the key cannot be changed afterwards.
templates.disableSelectedTitle: Disable {count, plural, one {# prompt} other {# prompts}}?
templates.disableSelectedIntro: They stop being offered to new generations. Sets already written from them are not touched.
templates.disableSelectedFailed: {count, plural, one {# prompt} other {# prompts}} could not be disabled and stay selected.
templates.empty: No prompts yet. Prompts are yours to write — copyable samples live in docs/qa.md §9 of the backend repo.
templates.footer: {from}–{to} of {total, plural, one {# prompt} other {# prompts}}
templates.defaultCount: {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} per set
templates.defaultSummary: {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} per set · {shape}
templates.sourceVariable: This prompt carries source variables ({variables}). The source travels in a separate half the backend assembles; putting it here means the cacheable prefix never repeats. The backend will refuse to save it.

fields.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Cannot be changed later.
fields.name: Display name
fields.variablesHint: The three source variables ({forbidden}) do not belong here: the source travels separately, and the leading half must stay byte-identical between runs for caching to hit.

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.intro: The textbook you paste in. Everything downstream is generated from it.
datasets.caption: Datasets
datasets.deleteBody: This deletes the dataset and its sources for good. It is only allowed while no set has been generated from it.

sources.title: Sources
sources.intro: Paste one chapter at a time. Content is normalised to Markdown as you paste.
sources.tooLong: Over {max} characters. Split it into smaller pieces — the backend refuses anything longer.
sources.addHint: Paste one chapter at a time

outlines.title: Outline versions
outlines.intro: Each analysis creates a new version. Older ones stay.
outlines.empty: No versions yet. Run an analysis to create the first one.
outlines.versionWarning: This dataset has {count, plural, one {# version} other {# versions}}. Nothing cleans them up and question sets point at them — the only way to remove them is deleting the dataset, and that is only possible before any set exists.
outlines.editorIntro: The model drafts, you sign off. The outline on the right is recomputed by the backend from the content — editing a section means editing its heading.
outlines.label: Note for this version
outlines.sectionsHint: Derived from the content, read-only. The `anchor` is what a generate call sends back.
outlines.noSections: The document has no headings yet, so there are no sections to generate questions for.
outlines.formatHint: Switching converts what you are editing into the other format; anything it cannot hold is dropped. This version changes only when you save.
outlines.deleteLastHint: The only version cannot be deleted
outlines.deleteBody: This version and its content are removed for good. If it is the current one, the newest remaining version becomes current. A version that question sets were generated from cannot be deleted.

run.noCredentialHint: No AI key is enabled. Add or enable one on the AI keys screen first.
run.contextTooltip: {label}: context window of {count} tokens (how much it can read at once). Change the model on the AI keys screen.
run.outputTooltip: {label}: up to {count} tokens of output per call.
run.modelUnavailable: This key's model ({label}) is switched off or cannot return structured JSON, so the call would be refused. Assign another model to the key on the AI keys screen.

analyze.title: Analyze into an outline
analyze.intro: Runs in the background for a few minutes. You can close this dialog and come back.
analyze.label: Note for the version about to be created
analyze.labelHint: Optional. A note makes versions tellable apart after several runs.
analyze.cost: Runs on key "{key}", model {model}. This call is billed for real.

chunk.title: How to split the source
chunk.needed: The selected sources are about {tokens} tokens, over the ~{budget} one call takes. They will be split into several parts that run one after another.
chunk.fits: The selected sources are about {tokens} tokens, under the ~{budget} one call takes, so they run as a single call. Set "Max tokens per part" below if you still want them cut into smaller parts.

modes.heading: By heading
modes.ai: Let AI find the cut points

modeHint.auto: Tries headings, then repeating markers like "Câu 12", then uppercase titles, then paragraphs.
modeHint.source: Cuts only between the sources you ticked.
modeHint.heading: Cuts before each heading up to the level below.
modeHint.pattern: Cuts before every line that matches the pattern.
modeHint.size: Cuts only to fit the size limit, at paragraph breaks.
modeHint.ai: The model picks where to cut. Costs one extra call and cannot be previewed.

chunk.patternHint: Tested against each line; a matching line starts a new part. Example: ^Câu \d+$
chunk.maxTokensHint: Optional, at least {min}. Smaller parts mean more calls, each cheaper and faster.
chunk.maxTokensInvalid: Enter a whole number of at least {min}, or leave it empty.
chunk.overlapHint: Last paragraphs of the previous part, given as read-only context.
chunk.previewHint: Preview is free and does not call the model.
chunk.needPromptForPreview: Pick an outline prompt to preview the split.
chunk.aiNoPreview: This mode cannot be previewed: the model decides where to cut, and it is billed when the run starts.

result.summary: {count, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}} · cut by {strategy} · about {total} tokens in all

generation.reused: A run with these exact parameters was already going — this is that run, not a second one.
generation.noWorker: The job has been queued for over a minute with no worker picking it up. Most likely QA_WORKER_ENABLED is off in this environment.
generation.succeeded: Done. {count, plural, one {# result} other {# results}}.
generation.partial: Done, but sections are MISSING. {count, plural, one {# result} other {# results}}.
generation.partialUnknown: The model returned fewer sections than were sent.
generation.tokens: Tokens: {input} in · {output} out · {cached} read from cache
generation.pollFailed: Could not read the run's status.
generation.retryFailed: Could not start the retry. Try again.

sets.title: Question sets
sets.caption: Question sets
sets.deleteBody: The set and all of its questions are erased and cannot be recovered. A set that learners have already attempted cannot be deleted — archive it instead.
sets.selected: {count, plural, one {# set selected} other {# sets selected}}
sets.footer: {selected} of {total, plural, one {# set} other {# sets}} selected
sets.bulkDeleteTitle: Delete {count, plural, one {# set} other {# sets}} permanently?
sets.bulkDeleteFailed: {count, plural, one {# set} other {# sets}} could not be deleted — learners have already attempted them. Archive those instead.
sets.removeBody: It is taken off the learner surface and marked Archived. Its questions are kept, but the set cannot be published again.
sets.removeFailed: The set could not be archived. Try again.
sets.lockedShape: This set has left draft, so its question shape is locked: changing it would make every question in it the wrong shape at once, including for someone taking it right now.
sets.noItems: No questions yet. An empty set cannot be published.
sets.optionsHint: Tick every option that is correct.
sets.needCorrect: Pick at least one correct option.
sets.needAccepted: Add at least one accepted answer.

items.title: Question types
items.intro: The question types the system supports. Open one to see its questions, preview the UI and choose whether each is published.
items.found: {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} match
items.summaryChoice: {count, plural, one {# option} other {# options}} · Correct: {correct}
items.publishFailed: Could not change whether this question is published.
items.previewMultiHint: More than one answer may be correct — pick all that apply.
items.previewIntro: Read-only preview of the {shape} question exactly as a learner sees it.
items.previewAnswerHint: Press Enter to answer · case and accents are ignored
items.previewFlashHint: Recall the answer in your head first, then say honestly whether you knew it. The back of the card shows after you choose.
items.previewFlashNote: Flashcards are self-assessed, so the result is counted apart from machine-graded questions.
items.previewEmpty: There is no question of this type yet.
items.previewFailed: Could not load a question of this type.
items.tagsHint: Shown to learners as a framed card with the label on its edge.

generate.title: Generate question sets
generate.countLimit: Limit the number of questions (off: the model decides)
generate.countHint: Total for the whole run (not per section); the model spreads them across the sections and the ticked question types. The maximum depends on the model's output limit.
generate.questionTypesHint: The model picks a type for each question from the ones ticked, and each type adds its own rules to the prompt.
generate.countAny: as many questions as the model sees fit
generate.allSections: All {count, plural, one {# section} other {# sections}}
generate.costWhole: Generating {count} from the whole outline, on key "{key}", model {model}. This call is billed for real.
generate.cost: Generating {count} from {sections, plural, one {# section} other {# sections}}, on key "{key}", model {model}. This call is billed for real.
generate.sectionTooLong: "{title}" is ≈ {tokens} tokens, over the {budget} tokens {model} can read in one call, and a section is never split. Break it into sub-sections in the outline, or pick a model with a larger window.
generate.modelTooSmall: {model} has no room left for the sources at this question count. Lower the maximum number of questions or pick a model with a larger context window.
generate.outputExceeded: Up to {max} questions needs at least {calls} calls on {model} (about {capacity} questions each), but only {sections, plural, one {# section is} other {# sections are}} picked to split across. Pick more sections or lower the count.
generate.calls: This is too much for one call, so it runs as {calls} calls, one after another, each billed.

models.title: AI models
models.intro: The catalogue of models a key can be assigned. The context window and output ceiling are the provider's figures and decide which calls are blocked before anything is billed — copy them from the provider's model page.
models.caption: AI models
models.deleteBody: Only possible while no key uses this model. To stop using it, switch it off instead.
models.empty: No models yet. A key cannot be created without one.

fields.name: Provider's model id
fields.nameHint: Exactly as the provider names it (e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 on OpenRouter, claude-sonnet-5 directly). Cannot be changed afterwards — the same model via another provider is a separate row.
fields.label: Display name
fields.maxOutputHint: Sent as the real max_tokens, so use the figure you want to allow, not the technical ceiling.
fields.maxOutputInvalid: A whole number between 1 and the context window.
fields.numberInvalid: A whole number of at least 1.
fields.structured: Can return JSON that matches a schema (structured output)

tags.title: Question tags
tags.intro: Labels attached to questions, such as "Critical question". A question with a tag is drawn in a framed card with the label on its edge. The description is what the AI reads to decide when to attach a tag.
tags.caption: Question tags

fields.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. This is the name the AI is given in the prompt.
fields.keyInvalid: Start with a letter; use lowercase letters, digits and underscores only.
fields.iconHint: A lucide icon name, e.g. lucide:info.
fields.iconInvalid: Pick an icon from the lucide set, e.g. lucide:info.
fields.keyRenameWarning: Questions are not affected, but prompts saved earlier still use the old key until you update them.
